findings.failure_path: Install an executable post-index-change hook through .git/hooks or core.hooksPath after constructing a clean integration fixture. The temporary-index read-tree writes an index, which invokes that hook; apply --cached can invoke it again. GIT_INDEX_FILE does not disable hooks, and the shown g wrapper disables only fsmonitor. Thus evaluating review coverage can execute a repository-configured program even though the diff commands themselves disable external helpers.
findings.smallest_fix: Disable Git hooks explicitly for these plumbing operations, for example by pinning core.hooksPath=/dev/null in g, and add a regression that installs a marker-writing post-index-change hook and asserts it never runs.

The path-disjoint narrowing (same-file target edits always remind) is deliberate.
